# TransferIntel

> Premier League transfer rumours and their sources scored for credibility, with transparent value-for-money verdicts.

Window: Premier League · Summer Window 2026. Last updated: Sep 24, 2026.

## Method

Credibility scores are computed in code, not written by a model. A score rises with the tier of the outlets reporting a claim and with independent corroboration, and decays when a deal goes quiet. Only tier 1 and tier 2 outlets can advance a deal's status. A completed transfer requires a tier 1 source. Scores are an assessment of how well supported a claim is. They are not predictions and not betting advice.

## Source credibility

A source gets one call per transfer, regardless of repeat coverage. Completed moves are hits, collapsed moves are misses, and unresolved calls are excluded from accuracy. The ranking is the transparent confidence-adjusted rate (hits + 2) / (resolved calls + 4).

- Fabrizio Romano: credibility 60, hit rate 100%, 1 hits, 0 misses, 3 unresolved
- FootballTransfers: credibility 50, hit rate 50%, 1 hits, 1 misses, 4 unresolved
- The Guardian: credibility 50, hit rate 50%, 1 hits, 1 misses, 3 unresolved
- Daily Mail: credibility 40, hit rate 0%, 0 hits, 1 misses, 5 unresolved
